metadata.title: Spain city open data catalog
metadata.scope: 74 selected large municipalities and regional or autonomous-city capitals; editorial coverage list, not a population ranking or an exhaustive catalog of all Spanish municipalities.
metadata.geography: Municipalities, not metropolitan areas. Regional entries require filtering and do not certify a nonempty result for every listed city.
metadata.validation: Publisher pages, catalog entries and documented formats were reviewed. Some resource content types were observed, but no underlying source dataset was downloaded and parsed end to end. Observed HTTP errors and untested/documentation-derived API URLs are flagged.
metadata.units: Dataset rows count distinct dataset families, not every annual file, format or municipality extract.

datasets.title: Population by municipality and sex (INE table 68065)
datasets.update_notes: Annual census table. Latest period must be read from returned observations; nult=1 requests the latest observation per series.
datasets.city_filter: Select the municipality dimension using INE series metadata; preserve official municipality codes as strings.
datasets.format_evidence: INE table plus official JSON API documentation
datasets.access_notes: Common baseline for all 74 cities. URL is constructed from the official DATOS_TABLA pattern, not a successfully parsed response. National dataset, not 74 separate municipal feeds.

datasets.title: Andalucía sports facility census
datasets.update_notes: Catalog metadata last modified 2021-07-01; treat freshness as unconfirmed.
datasets.city_filter: Filter municipio and provincia; confirm that the selected city has records.
datasets.access_notes: Facility type, ownership and sports spaces. Regional coverage is not a guarantee of a populated row for every city.

datasets.title: Comunitat Valenciana educational centres
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution; version not confirmed
datasets.update_notes: Publisher states weekly updates.
datasets.city_filter: Use localidad and provincia; a municipality may contain several localities, so confirm the geographic mapping.
datasets.access_notes: School code, type, postal code, locality, province, latitude and longitude.

datasets.title: Catalan local government budgets: economic and programme classifications
datasets.update_notes: Annual. Catalog metadata updated 2026-10-05; first published 2023-12-19. Read any_exercici for actual observation years.
datasets.city_filter: Filter codi_ens / nom_complert. The landing page is a Sant Cugat view of the shared Catalan dataset; the API URL here removes its city filter.
datasets.access_notes: Documented Sant Cugat filter: filters={"CODI_ENS":"820550006"}. Use API field metadata to confirm exact key casing. Values include revenue/expense, account classification and amount. Paginate datastore_search.

datasets.title: Euskadi sports facility census
datasets.license: Publisher reuse terms; review linked legal notice
datasets.update_notes: Monthly; catalog coverage end 2026-09-30.
datasets.city_filter: Select municipality or spatially intersect facilities with the municipality boundary.
datasets.access_notes: The advertised GeoJSON link returned 404 during checking. XLSX and JSON alternatives are listed, but were not parsed or validated. Do not treat this as a confirmed working GeoJSON feed.

datasets.title: Castilla y León tourism monument inventory
datasets.update_notes: Publisher states daily updates Monday to Friday.
datasets.city_filter: Filter the published municipality/locality and province fields; inspect the schema first.
datasets.access_notes: Dataset ID relacion-monumentos. API and export interfaces exist, but JavaScript prevented verification of an exact downloadable CSV endpoint. Use the API tab; a CSV URL is deliberately not guessed.

datasets.title: Mallorca interurban public transport timetable (TIB / CTM)
datasets.update_notes: Current feed linked by publisher; verify feed_info and calendar validity after extraction.
datasets.city_filter: Select Palma stops and related routes/trips; regional interurban network, not a substitute for the entire EMT Palma city network.
datasets.access_notes: GTFS contains structured text tables for stops, routes, trips and scheduled times. Static schedules, not real-time vehicle positions.

datasets.title: Madrid hourly air quality, historical archive since 2001
datasets.update_notes: Monthly. Updated 2026-09-28; coverage through 2026-08-31. The linked CSV covers 2025 onward; older years have separate archives.
datasets.access_notes: The timestamped file URL can change after refresh; retain the landing page for resource discovery. Check station and pollutant codes, units and validity flags.

datasets.title: Barcelona transport facilities inventory
datasets.update_notes: Published 2026-07-16, but the observed dataset refers to 2021. Do not equate publication date with data freshness.
datasets.access_notes: Look for opendatabcn_varis-transports-csv.csv or opendatabcn_varis-transports.json. The portal requires JavaScript for the export controls.

datasets.title: Port of Barcelona ship departures, 2026
datasets.update_notes: Annual 2026 resource listed; update cadence and completeness not independently confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: Port authority data, not municipal transport data. Separate resources exist for other years.

datasets.title: Valencia gardens and green spaces
datasets.update_notes: No reliable last-observation date seen.
datasets.access_notes: Location, neighbourhood and garden type. The advertised CSV returned 404 on checking; JSON and GIS alternatives are listed but not confirmed working. Use VAL-SCHOOLS as a different-topic fallback, not as a replacement for garden data.

datasets.title: Zaragoza monuments with opening information and coordinates
datasets.update_notes: API documentation verified; individual record freshness not confirmed.
datasets.format_evidence: Official API documentation with example response
datasets.access_notes: Example returns only up to 100 rows. Paginate using start/rows and totalCount. Coordinates default to UTM30; documentation shows srsname=wgs84 for longitude/latitude. Registration is described as optional.

datasets.title: Zaragoza greenhouse gas inventory by year, district and sector
datasets.update_notes: Documentation examples include 2019, 2021 and 2023; query the years endpoint to discover available inventory years.
datasets.format_evidence: Official API documentation with example response
datasets.access_notes: The linked query is a residential-buildings example, not the full inventory. Use documented district and sector endpoints to enumerate dimensions; keep pollutant units and inventory scopes separate.

datasets.title: Málaga municipal solid waste container locations
datasets.update_notes: Resource date observed 2025-09-17; some catalog metadata dates back to 2017.
datasets.access_notes: WGS84 / EPSG:4326 export. Confirm coordinate column names and axis order before ingestion.

datasets.title: Murcia overnight visitor statistics
datasets.update_notes: Annual; catalog date observed 2023-09-21. Current observation period not confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: JSON distribution listed; follow its resource link from the CKAN-backed municipal transparency portal. Reuse license was not clearly specified.

datasets.title: Guaguas Municipales bus stops
datasets.publisher: Ayuntamiento de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria / Guaguas Municipales
datasets.update_notes: Not confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: Catalog title: Guaguas Municipales Paradas. A dataset-specific resource URL was not recovered; portal returned a gateway error during direct access. Do not treat the catalog homepage as a CSV URL.

datasets.title: Bilbao cadastral parcels
datasets.publisher: Diputación Foral de Bizkaia / Open Data Bizkaia
datasets.update_notes: Monthly; national catalog metadata dated 2026-06-11.
datasets.access_notes: Provincial publisher; dataset is specifically scoped to Bilbao. JSON variant is advertised using format=json. Confirm geometry encoding and coordinate system from the schema.

datasets.title: Córdoba road traffic crashes
datasets.license: No license specified in the observed dataset metadata
datasets.update_notes: Complete annual resources listed for 2019–2023; the 2024 resource covers only through June. Metadata updated 2024-09-23.
datasets.access_notes: Direct URL selects 2023. Machine readable does not itself establish permission for unrestricted reuse; clarify licensing before redistribution.

datasets.title: L’Hospitalet BiciBox bicycle parking locations and occupancy
datasets.publisher: Ajuntament de L’Hospitalet de Llobregat / Consorci AOC
datasets.update_notes: Catalog date observed 2026-10-07; actual occupancy timestamp and refresh interval must be checked.
datasets.access_notes: Use the CSV/JSON data resource, not the separate PDF resource or package_show metadata. Paginate with limit and offset; inspect result.fields.

datasets.title: Gijón air quality measurements from the last week
datasets.update_notes: Catalog describes a rolling last-week dataset; exact refresh interval not confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: Select the air-quality last-week dataset from the catalog. Exact dataset/download URL not recovered. Station information is also separately listed.

datasets.title: Vitoria-Gasteiz minor public contracts
datasets.license: Municipal reuse terms; check linked conditions
datasets.update_notes: Catalog describes quarterly updates with cumulative annual resources.
datasets.access_notes: Choose the required year and its CSV export; dataset landing is HTML, not a file.

datasets.title: Terrassa restaurant directory
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution; version not confirmed
datasets.update_notes: Monthly according to the national catalog.

datasets.title: Terrassa municipal budgets
datasets.update_notes: Download page lists years 2010–2026.
datasets.access_notes: Choose a year and revenue/expenditure export; retain classification codes as strings.

datasets.title: Terrassa neighbourhood and administrative boundary layers
datasets.update_notes: Not confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: GeoJSON/KML for neighbourhoods, districts, postal-code and census layers; CSV applies to selected street/district tables, not necessarily each boundary layer. Check the CRS: portal notes ETRS89, with KML in WGS84.

datasets.title: Sabadell population by district, sex and nationality
datasets.update_notes: Select the year explicitly; freshness not confirmed.
datasets.access_notes: Dataset is listed among CSV population tables. Download requires selecting the relevant dataset/year. Shared CAT-BUDGET is a separately documented API option.

datasets.title: Cartagena municipal sports facilities
datasets.license: Regional reuse terms linked; license label empty
datasets.update_notes: Monthly; catalog metadata dated 2026-09-04.
datasets.access_notes: Cartagena in Spain. Municipality publishes through the Región de Murcia catalog.

datasets.title: Pamplona municipal budget exports
datasets.license: Conflicting portal-level notices: municipal page CC BY 3.0; national initiative CC0. Check the selected resource.
datasets.update_notes: Mixed historical datasets; select and verify budget year. Other statistics on this page include older 2008–2015 series.
datasets.access_notes: Portal confirms formats, but a current-year budget file was not independently located. Included as a machine-readable discovery lead, not a fully verified current feed.

datasets.title: Alcalá de Henares public car parks
datasets.update_notes: Catalog last modification observed 2022-06-29.
datasets.access_notes: Static car park inventory, not confirmed live space availability.

datasets.title: Fuenlabrada drinking water quality
datasets.update_notes: Catalog last modification observed 2022-07-04.
datasets.access_notes: The /ro/ path is a portal interface locale, not a statement about the language of the data. Check sampling dates before using as current water-quality evidence.

datasets.title: Donostia / San Sebastián active postal addresses
datasets.license: Portal footer CC BY-SA; version and resource applicability should be checked
datasets.update_notes: Catalog updated 2026-10-04. Description says daily, but frequency metadata says monthly; discrepancy unresolved.
datasets.access_notes: Address, type, X/Y, neighbourhood, district, census section and cadastral reference. ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N, EPSG:25830. Do not interpret X/Y as longitude/latitude.

datasets.title: Santander TUS bus schedules
datasets.update_notes: Schedule feed; verify service calendar after extraction. Catalog frequency labels should not be read as real-time arrivals.
datasets.access_notes: GTFS ZIP for the complete timetable; CSV/JSON resources for related timetable tables. Observed publisher download uses an HTTP proxy around an HTTPS target; review transport security before automation.

datasets.title: Logroño measurement station readings, last 90 days
datasets.update_notes: Title says rolling 90 days; metadata says annual updates. Inspect observation timestamps before treating it as a live feed.
datasets.access_notes: Resolve cadence discrepancy and confirm reuse terms before production use.

datasets.title: Girona building permits
datasets.license: Municipal reproduction/reuse terms; review dataset terms
datasets.update_notes: Annual files listed for 2013–2025. Direct URL selects 2025; completeness not independently checked.
datasets.access_notes: A dated file is useful for reproducible historical analysis. Do not assume the listed latest year is complete.

datasets.title: Alcobendas metro stops
datasets.update_notes: Monthly claimed; catalog metadata observed 2024-10-03.
datasets.access_notes: 403 may reflect host access controls or the research tool, not a permanently unavailable public dataset. Recheck from a normal client; alternative formats are listed.

discovery.name: Spain national open data catalog
discovery.purpose: Discover dataset metadata and distribution links across publishers; does not return the underlying dataset rows.
discovery.notes: Official API documentation: https://datos.gob.es/es/accessible-apidata . Catalog pagination uses _page and _pageSize (maximum 50).

discovery.name: FEMP local open data directory
discovery.purpose: Discover municipal portal and dataset leads; directory membership is not a guarantee of live downloads.

discovery.name: INE JSON API documentation
discovery.purpose: Fetch observation data from INE tables; unlike catalog APIs, DATOS_TABLA returns statistical series.
discovery.notes: Use SERIES_TABLA / metadata to discover filter values; do not invent municipality codes or variable identifiers.

discovery.name: CKAN API documentation
discovery.purpose: Understand metadata discovery versus record retrieval.
discovery.notes: package_search/package_show return metadata; datastore_search returns records only for resources with DataStore support. A CKAN portal does not guarantee every resource has a queryable table.

discovery.name: Zaragoza REST API
discovery.purpose: Documented data endpoints with JSON, CSV and GeoJSON response formats.
discovery.notes: The api_url here is catalog metadata. Use dataset endpoints in the Datasets table for actual observations.

discovery.name: Madrid regional transport portal (CRTM)
discovery.purpose: Additional transport discovery lead for Madrid-region municipalities.
discovery.notes: Portal observed, but specific transport exports were not verified. Not counted as a dataset in this catalog.

discovery.name: Granada provincial catalog
discovery.purpose: Additional provincial tourism, geography and statistics discovery lead.
discovery.notes: CSV and GeoJSON examples appear in the catalog. Municipality-level applicability and export payloads were not checked; not counted as a dataset.
